race.comment: JENNI MULTABELLA (16) made a wide run into the straight here last time out when well supported, just collared late in a strongly run race. Drawn wide here but is still open to more improvement. She might look to roll forward here and can win. CAVALRY (14) didn't fire first up at Warwick Farm over 1400m but did bolt in second up last time in and should be a sharp improver here from a good gate. EMPEROR TZU (3) has won two on the bounce, proving too strong for a handy one last time out. Should be up on speed again and hard to run down. POLITELY DUN (2) had the right tempo to win here last time and will be running on again.
